No strong directional edge; most candidates warrant near-SPY expectations with only a few modest overreaction cases.
portfolio_rationale: Edges are thin. Cybersecurity is the cleanest quality pullback: universe-leading prior relative trend, modest recent giveback, neutral volume. Large value offers low-vol, low-duration exposure suited to high oil, rising yields, and a hawkish-leaning FOMC. Extended winners (Taiwan, semis, crypto) lack in-window support and carry high beta into CPI/FOMC; persistent losers (defense, China, solar) look like deterioration rather than shock.
key_risks: August CPI (Sept 11) or FOMC (Sept 15-16) surprises hawkish given three hike dissenters, hitting high-beta candidates; Oil above $100 spills into broader growth downgrade, widening the drawdown in cyclicals and small caps; Cybersecurity's strong prior trend could keep unwinding rather than revert, given 31.5% volatility; Weak breadth (4.1:1 decliners) develops into a broader correction, making relative bets irrelevant versus absolute losses
